$comment: CRISSP: the parts of {{PRODUCT}}: what every run, crissp/check.sh's map and the dashboard are made of. By default the backend is app/backend, the frontend app/frontend, and docker-compose.yml at the root runs them together; several backends or frontends are app/backend-<name> and app/frontend-<name>, each with its own steps and path rule (CRISSP.md: Several parts); a step exists once its part does (`when`); a parallel step spreads its tests over the workers this machine has. crissp/testsuite/lib/project.py says what each field means; python3 crissp/testsuite/lib/project.py check says what is wrong.

steps.label: CRISSP: the backend's tests (pytest under coverage)
CRISSP: the backend's lint (ruff, with its security rules)
CRISSP: the frontend's lint (ESLint and stylelint, crissp's own)
CRISSP: CVEs and misconfigurations (pip-audit, npm audit, trivy)
CRISSP: secrets in the git history (gitleaks)
CRISSP: unsafe code (Semgrep with crissp's rules)
CRISSP: code quality, complexity and duplication may only get better (lizard)
CRISSP: licences of every dependency, and the SBOM (CycloneDX)
CRISSP: the running app, scanned passively (OWASP ZAP baseline)

shared.why: what git runs before every commit (the lint steps)
